text:
message: I ask you to pray for me, my dear brother
reply: 🙇 In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit ❤️✝️🕊️ : 
🙏 May the LORD lead others to provide you with an abundance of prayer! May the LORD always bless you, your family, your church and your country exceedingly abundantly more than anyone can ask or think! Amen! 🙏
